page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on KVM hypervisor technology. It features 4 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system provides 8.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a 2.0 GB per vCPU memory allocation ratio.

The instance operates without integrated local storage, requiring attached block storage solutions for persistent data needs. It includes a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no discrete GPUs present in this configuration.

The 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio aligns with standard compute-dense infrastructure patterns, delivering dedicated CPU resources for compute-intensive tasks while maintaining efficient memory overhead. It is suited for web application server hosting, CI/CD pipelines, code compilation, and general computational tasks where dedicated processing allocation is required without large memory allocations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.xlarge is a compute-optimized x86_64 server instance powered by 4 dedicated Intel Xeon 8475B vCPUs running at 2.7 GHz. Managed via the KVM hypervisor, the instance includes 8.0 GB of total RAM, maintaining a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB of memory per core. The instance provides a baseline network speed of 4 Gbps. It includes no local disk storage, necessitating remote block storage attachment, and features no dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. By prioritizing dedicated processing capacity over memory scaling, the ecs.c8i.xlarge offers an efficient core-dense environment for application servers, code compilation, continuous integration pipelines, microservices, and general compute workloads requiring consistent CPU execution.
